english.title: Make false statement re financial circumstances order
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) in furnishing a statement in pursuance of a financial circumstances order made by **(..SPECIFY COURT..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE ORDER MADE..) under section 35 of the Sentencing Act 2020, made a statement that you knew to be false in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 36(3)(a) and (4) of the Sentencing Act 2020.
english.pointstoprove:

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 36(3)(b) makes it an offence to recklessly furnish a statement which is false in a material particular, section 36(3)(c) to knowingly fail to disclose a material fact, see H22531 / SE20009 and H22532 / SE20010.
(ii) Section 36(1) makes failure to comply with a financial circumstances order an offence, see H22529 / SE20007.
(iii) Proceedings for this offence may be commenced at any time which is both within two years from the date of the offence and within six months from its first discovery by the prosecutor, see section 36(5).
